jobs.occupation: Jentas is looking for a technically proficient part-time graphic designer with AI experience
jobs.description:
The publishing house Jentas is looking for a part-time graphic designer with a razor-sharp eye for good visual craftsmanship and experience working purposefully and constructively with AI.

Would you like to work for a dynamic and innovative publisher? Do you know what a cover that grabs the reader’s attention looks like? Are you detail-oriented when creating graphic products but able to zoom out to the bigger picture when prioritising your tasks? Do you have experience using AI to work more efficiently and deliver even better results? And are you ready for new challenges and not afraid to find alternative solutions?

Then you may be the person we are looking for.

Jentas (part of Bonnier Books) is a small publishing house specialising in the translation of crime, thriller and feel-good fiction from English into a wide range of other European languages, including Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Finnish, Polish, German and more. With us, you will be part of a close-knit team of graphic designers, publishers and project developers, and your tasks will centre on graphic production and on developing and improving graphic workflows.

This will involve:

• Designing covers for Jentas’ many new releases, primarily within the thriller, crime and feel-good genres

• Typesetting and, where relevant, entering corrections from proofreaders etc.

• Ongoing optimisation of graphic workflows, including through the use of AI and new technical tools to strengthen efficiency and quality

• Ad hoc graphical tasks of a smaller nature, e.g. related to the publisher’s social media presence, attendance at book fairs and similar

We therefore envision that you…

• Are an Adobe suite power user and are familiar with other relevant graphic design programs

• Have experience with and an interest in new AI tools, both for use in the graphic work itself and for optimising graphic workflows

• Have a strong eye for composition, aesthetics, typography, contrast, imagery and more

• Are structured and detail-oriented, and thrive when working independently

• Can plan and prioritise your tasks and are able to both set and meet deadlines

• Are good at collaborating internally in a small team where cooperation, sparring and shared development are crucial, and are also able to communicate precisely and smoothly with external partners

• Feel comfortable communicating both verbally and in writing in English and, ideally, another European language, which may be Danish but does not have to be

We also expect that you…

• Ideally have at least 1–2 years of experience as a graphic designer

• Have experience with print production, preferably for book publishing

We expect to interview candidates on an ongoing basis and would like to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 10 November. The position will be filled once the right candidate has been found.

The position is a part-time role of 25 hours per week, based at the publisher’s address. Start date preferably 11 January or as soon as possible hereafter.

Workplace: Smallegade 46B, 1st floor, 2000 Frederiksberg

Please send your application, CV, portfolio and any references by email, with the subject line “Grafiker”, to Chief Graphic Designer Holger Lund at holger@jentas.dk. Feel free to write your application in Danish or English, whichever suits you best. See also www.jentas.dk for a Danish version of this job post.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Director, Creative Operations
jobs.description:
Location: Copenhagen

We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

Creative Operations & Project Management

• 
Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• 
Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• 
Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• 
Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

• 
Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• 
Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• 
Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• 
Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

Agency & Vendor Management

• 
Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• 
Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• 
Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

Change Management & Transformation

• 
Lead change initiatives that enable successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.

• 
Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

• 
Influence stakeholders across the business to deliver sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

Budget & Resource Management

• 
Own budget planning for Creative Operations systems, technology investments, and operational needs in partnership with the Head of Production.

• 
Forecast and optimize resource allocation across internal teams and external partners.

• 
Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

Qualifications & Experience

• 
Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• 
Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• 
Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

• 
Experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI-enabled or automation solutions within creative, marketing, or operational environments.

• 
Experience leading RFPs, developing business cases, and delivering technology implementations in partnership with Digital & Technology teams.

• 
Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, content production, localization, and asset management.

• 
Demonstrated success managing agency and vendor partnerships, including localization, customization, and technology providers.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills.

• 
Proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across complex organizations.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

• 
Experience with budget planning, financial management, and investment prioritization.

• 
Passion for leveraging technology, automation, and innovation to improve creative effectiveness and operational excellence.

Reports to: VP Brand Creative

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Experienced ServiceNow GRC Product Owner
jobs.description:

Join us in this role where you'll own and drive governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) products on the ServiceNow platform, from development to operation and adoption. With your strong functional experience on ServiceNow’s Integrated Risk Management (IRM) module, you will guide, scope and translate business needs into product roadmaps and prioritized backlogs, collaborate closely with stakeholders, and deliver best-practice solutions built on ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities.

Welcome to Process Automation Platform Product Suite

You'll become part of the ServiceNow GRC product team within the Process Automation Platform Product Suite consisting of 5 product teams, all centralized around products from the ServiceNow platform. As the ServiceNow GRC Product Owner, you will have a consolidated team of external consultants, where you as a team develops and maintains GRC products across IT and OT, working closely with other product teams, leadership and global stakeholders to ensure strong adoption and measurable business value from the Integrated Risk Management module and the ServiceNow platform in general. We offer a collaborative and international working environment characterized by trust, openness, and shared ownership. We believe in succeeding as one team and supporting each other's development through continuous learning and empowerment.

You'll play an important role in:

• 
owning and maintaining a structured product backlog for deliverables of the ServiceNow GRC product team

• 
prioritizing initiatives and features to maximize business value while balancing roadmap commitments and team capacity within each quarterly planning

• 
engaging stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs and translate them into scalable platform solutions

• 
advising stakeholders on ServiceNow IRM capabilities and guiding solution decisions based on out-of-the-box functionality and platform best practices

• 
driving adoption and continuous improvement of governance, risk, and compliance products on the ServiceNow platform

• 
collaborating closely with architects, developers, and delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and release of product features

• 
supporting the delivery of regulatory and compliance-related capabilities across a complex global business environment

• 
strengthening collaboration, transparency, and productivity within the product team and across stakeholder communities

To succeed in the role, you:

• 
have a proven track record in delivering GRC products from ServiceNow’s IRM module that operationalise policies and regulatory requirements in IT and OT

• 
adhere to ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities from documented know-how and functional experience on the IRM module on how these are applied in practice to advise stakeholders, define implementation strategies, shape roadmaps and have measurable outcomes

• 
have experience prioritizing a product backlog with mature features delivering business value in large organizations using SAFe, Agile, or similar product delivery frameworks

• 
are adept in project management with deliveries from external consultants according to budget and agreed timelines

• 
excel at engaging stakeholders across multiple organisational levels, navigating priorities, aligning roadmaps and dependencies, including facilitating complex dialogues with subject matter experts and senior leaders

• 
thrive in supporting governance, risk, compliance, security, or regulatory processes within enterprise environments

• 
bring a strong value-focused mindset in addressing demands, ensuring adoption and realised business benefits of technology solutions

• 
show confident leadership and communication skills, with the ability to work with diverse global teams and build team engagement through empowerment and collaboration

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

jobs.occupation: Senior OT Incident Engineer
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you safeguard the stability and resilience of operational technology systems that underpin offshore and onshore renewable energy generation.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

You’ll play an important role in:

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Process consultant - Viby DK
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn complex procurement processes into practical digital solutions that create measurable business value? And are you motivated by working at the intersection of business, process improvement and technology?

“As our new Senior Business Process Consultant, you will connect business needs with digital opportunities within Procurement. You will join our Digital S2C Excellence team, part of Procurement Data and Digital Excellence, where you will work across Procurement, business functions and digital teams to improve the way we work and help translate business requirements into effective processes and solutions”, says Anette Falk Bøgebjerg, Head of Data & Digital Excellence for Procurement.

How you will make an impact

Reporting to the Head of Digital S2C Excellence, you will play an important role in developing and improving Arla's source-to-contract and procure-to-pay processes. Combining process knowledge, data and stakeholder insights, you will identify improvement opportunities, help design solutions and support their implementation across the organisation.

Your key responsibilities will be to

• Facilitate business process improvements and collaborate with stakeholders to define and document clear objectives, requirements and opportunities for improvement.

• Analyse process and performance data to identify trends, challenge existing ways of working and recommend improvements.

• Design process and digital solutions that support business priorities, working closely with Digital Business Consultants and relevant Procurement and business teams.

• Maintain high-quality process documentation, define and monitor performance metrics and ensure alignment with Arla's process framework.

• Support change management, stakeholder training and the successful handover of improved processes to operational teams.

What will make you successful

For this role, we are looking for someone with 2-3 years of Procurement category knowledge and preferably an understanding of Source-to-Pay processes.

You have a Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field, are interested in how digital solutions and data can enable better ways of working, and you are comfortable turning business requirements and analysis into practical recommendations. LEAN background would be an advantage.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters is that you bring solid knowledge about source to contract processes and are motivated to develop your expertise further in a complex, international Procurement environment.

To succeed in the role, you

• Approach complex challenges with curiosity and use data and critical thinking to understand problems and identify practical solutions.

• Build constructive relationships across functions and can communicate requirements and ideas clearly to different stakeholders.

• Take ownership of your work while actively collaborating with others to create improvements that work in practice.

As Arla is an international organisation, professional proficiency in English is required.

What do we offer?

You will become part of Digital S2C Excellence within Procurement Data and Digital Excellence in Aarhus. The team has adopted agile ways of working and you will work in an  environment where business expertise, data and digital capabilities come together to improve the way Procurement operates.

The position offers an opportunity to build your expertise in business process management and digital transformation while working with colleagues across functions and geographies. You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements while developing your professional capabilities within a global organisation.

We are committed to professional development and creating a collaborative environment where colleagues share knowledge and support each other in delivering results. You will join a global, farmer-owned dairy cooperative working to create value for our customers, our farmer owners and the wider world.

Would you like to join us?

If you would like to combine your category experience and business process skills with data and digital solutions to help shape the future of Procurement at Arla, we would be pleased to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we will process applications on a continuous basis and close the recruitment once the right candidate is found.

For additional information about the position, please contact Head of Data & Digital Excellence, Anette Falk Bøgebjerg at anefb@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Service Director, Nordic
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take ownership of a Nordic service organisation and build a more integrated, efficient and customer-focused operation across Denmark and Sweden? Join Ramcon and play a key role in strengthening service performance, developing people and processes, and supporting profitable growth in a specialized Nordic LabTech and MedTech  business.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon distributes its products and solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland and employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden. The company operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm, and Gothenburg.

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The Service Director Nordic will have overarching responsibility for Ramcon’s Nordic service business and will be a member of the Nordic Leadership Team. The position combines people leadership, operational management and business development, with full P&L responsibility for the service business and responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into efficient operations and measurable results.

With direct responsibility for the Danish service business and overarching leadership of the service organisations in Denmark and Sweden, the Service Director Nordic will work closely with local Service Managers and Service Leaders. The role is responsible for building a stable, scalable and customer-focused Nordic service organisation, while strengthening collaboration with Sales, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

• Operational and direct leadership and development of the Nordic service organisation

• P&L responsibility, budgeting and performance follow-up for the Nordic service business

• Leadership and support of local Service Managers and Service Leaders in daily operations and long-term planning

• Standardisation and continuous improvement of service processes across Denmark and Sweden and preparation for local service presence in Norway and Finland

• Resource coordination and effective utilisation of service capacity across the Nordic organisation

• Development, implementation and follow-up of relevant KPIs

• Overarching responsibility for service contract sales and contract renewals

• Strengthening collaboration between Sales and Service and supporting customer-focused commercial execution

• Development of strong relationships and proactive communication with customers and suppliers

• Supporting digitalisation and automation of service workflows

Nordic leadership with operational impact

The Service Director Nordic will play a central role in developing Ramcon’s service organisation into a more integrated Nordic function. Success in the position requires the ability to combine strategic perspective with hands-on operational leadership while creating clear priorities, accountability and collaboration across countries and functions.

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced service leader with a proven track record of creating results through people, structure and disciplined execution in a technical B2B environment. You understand the commercial importance of a high-performing service organisation and can balance customer needs, quality, resource utilization and financial performance.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience in leading service teams across multiple locations

• Strong people leadership capabilities and experience in developing managers and specialists

• Experience with P&L responsibility, budgeting, KPIs and performance management

• A structured approach to process improvement, resource planning and operational excellence

• Commercial understanding and experience with service agreements, contract sales or renewals

• The ability to build trust and collaboration across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• A pragmatic and action-oriented leadership style combined with a strategic Nordic perspective

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

Apply now

The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with the consulting company Compass Human Resources Group. If you want to learn more about this position, please do not hesitate to contact Senior Research Consultant, Tobias Møller Simonsen at +45 70 20 12 75. Please submit your CV as soon as possible if you are interested. Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

Deadline for application: As soon as possible

Workplace: Ramcon HQ in Birkerød

Reference: 2618.229

Company: Ramcon

jobs.occupation: Senior Tax Reporting Specialist for Global Tax Reporting
jobs.description:
Where expertise meets impact: join us and help shape Saxo’s global CRS and FATCA tax reporting.

About the Job

Saxo is seeking a Senior Tax Reporting Specialist to join our Global Tax Reporting team with a specific focus on CRS and FATCA reporting. In this role, you will play a crucial part in navigating the complex tax landscape, ensuring Saxo's compliance with CRS and FATCA regulations. You will drive activities across jurisdictions to ensure Saxo's compliance with relevant legislation, market practices, and internal rules.

At Saxo, we pride ourselves on fostering a growth-embracing culture. You thrive in a dynamic, ambitious, yet informal and welcoming work environment. We are committed to your personal and professional development, offering ample opportunities for career advancement. Work alongside the best in the industry and make a real impact.

Responsibilities

As our new Senior Tax Reporting Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and compliant CRS and FATCA reporting, with a strong focus on data analysis, due diligence and reporting controls. You will work hands-on with large and complex data sets throughout the end-to-end reporting process and help ensure that reporting data is complete, accurate and ready for submission.

In addition, you will contribute to defining and maintaining reporting requirements and ensuring that reportable amounts and personally identifiable information (PII) data fields are correctly specified and delivered in the required formats.

Other responsibilities include:

• Preparing, analysing and validating large data sets used for CRS and FATCA due diligence and reporting.

• Performing due diligence activities, including generating, testing and validating data to identify inconsistencies, exceptions and potential reporting issues.

• Designing, implementing and maintaining data-driven controls and reconciliations to ensure completeness and accuracy throughout the reporting process.

• Investigating data discrepancies and reporting errors, identifying root causes and supporting their resolution.

• Developing and maintaining efficient Excel-based analyses, validation models and other tools supporting the reporting process.

• Acting as a frontrunner in identifying and implementing AI and automation opportunities across tax reporting processes, data analysis and controls, with the aim of reducing manual activities and improving efficiency, scalability and quality.

• Maintaining a comprehensive log of reporting errors and supporting mitigation and remediation activities.

• Working closely with technology and other stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into clear data and system requirements.

• Monitoring changes to reporting requirements and XML schemas and assessing their impact on data, controls and reporting processes.

• Delivering CRS and FATCA reports globally to high standards of completeness, accuracy and timeliness.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who enjoys working hands-on with data and investigating why numbers or data do not look as expected. You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with large and complex data sets, identifying patterns, exceptions and inconsistencies.

You are structured and detail-oriented, but also able to understand the bigger picture and translate regulatory requirements into practical data checks and controls. You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving complex problems and are motivated by continuously improving and automating processes.

You are also curious about how AI, automation and emerging technologies can improve the way tax reporting is performed, and you are motivated to take a leading role in identifying and implementing new solutions within the team.

Further:

• Relevant degree in accounting, finance, economics, data analytics, business administration or a related field, combined with strong practical experience in data analysis and reporting.

• Strong experience working with large and complex data sets and performing data analysis and validation.

• Experience designing or operating data controls, reconciliations and exception-based reviews.

• Advanced Excel skills, including experience building structured models using complex formulas, data validation and data transformation.

• Experience with Power BI, SQL or similar data analysis tools is a strong advantage.

• Strong interest in AI and automation and the ability to identify practical opportunities for applying new technologies to reporting processes and controls.

• Experience with financial, regulatory or tax reporting is an advantage.

• Experience with CRS and FATCA is a plus, but not a prerequisite if you have a strong data and reporting background.

• Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to investigate data issues systematically from identification through to root cause.

• Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

jobs.occupation: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About the job

At Saxo, we believe access to global capital markets should be simple and accessible. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will play a key role in supporting Saxo's continued growth, innovation and strategic ambitions.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will provide trusted legal advice across a broad range of business initiatives, regulatory developments, corporate matters, commercial activities, governance matters and strategic projects. Working closely with stakeholders across our offices in both Denmark and abroad, you will help ensure that legal considerations enable business success while maintaining the highest standards of governance, integrity and regulatory compliance.

This role combines strong legal expertise with stakeholder management and business partnership. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will act as a trusted advisor across Saxo, providing pragmatic legal guidance and partnering with stakeholders at all levels of the organisation to navigate legal complexity and support informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will:

• Provide strategic legal advice to key stakeholders across Saxo.

• Support commercial, corporate, governance and regulatory matters affecting the business.

• Advise on marketing activities, customer communications, commercial partnerships and strategic business initiatives.

• Partner with business stakeholders to ensure legal risks are appropriately identified and managed.

• Support product development, business expansion initiatives and corporate projects.

• Contribute to effective legal governance frameworks and decision-making processes.

• Collaborate closely with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit and other control functions.

• Manage relationships with external counsel and legal service providers.

• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

• Contribute to the continuous development of the Legal function and strengthen its role as a proactive business partner.

Your profile

You are an experienced legal professional with a strong legal foundation and a proven ability to navigate complex business challenges in a highly regulated environment.

You bring solid legal expertise, sound commercial judgement and the credibility to serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the organisation. You are comfortable balancing legal risk with business priorities and have a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to legal advisory.

To succeed in this role, you will preferably have:

• A master's degree in law or an equivalent legal qualification.

• Solidlegal experience preferably gained either within the financial services industry or at a leading law firm advising clients in regulated sectors.

• Understanding of the legal and regulatory framework governing financial institutions and financial markets.

• Experience advising business stakeholders on legal matters in relation to strategic initiatives and commercial matters.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal matters into practical business advice.

• A proactive, commercially minded and collaborative approach.

Beyond your technical legal capabilities, you are a trusted business partner who builds strong relationships across the organisation and enables informed decision-making while maintaining a high standard of legal governance and integrity.

We get curious people invested in the world

Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

• 
Job-ID: 372049

• 
Dato for opslag: 18/10/2026

Who you are

Are you good at creating an overview, keeping operations running smoothly, and motivating the people around you? Do you thrive in a hands-on environment where you actively participate in day-to-day tasks on the warehouse floor while also providing valuable support to team leaders? If so, you could be the colleague we are looking for to join our fulfilment team.

We are looking for a dedicated and responsible Fulfilment Operations Coordinator to join our evening shift. Your main responsibility will be to ensure efficient operations through coordination, prioritisation, and support for the team. You will act as the link between co-workers and team leaders, taking responsibility for daily operations when team leaders are not present.

You will be a visible role model on the warehouse floor, thrive on taking initiative, and be motivated by creating structure and maintaining momentum in a busy operational environment.

We imagine that you:

•Have experience in warehousing, logistics, or fulfilment.

•Are good at maintaining an overview and staying calm in a busy working environment.

•Enjoy coordinating and supporting colleagues with daily operations during the evening shift.

•Work in a structured, efficient, and solution-oriented manner.

•Are responsible and naturally take ownership of tasks and processes.

•Have experience in team coordination or leadership, which is an advantage but not a requirement.

A day in your life with us

As a Fulfilment Operations Coordinator, you will play an important role in the evening shift and actively contribute to daily operations. Your responsibilities will include:

•Coordinating and supporting daily operations during the evening shift.

•Ensuring a smooth flow throughout picking and fulfilment processes.

•Actively participating in picking and other operational tasks as needed.

•Prioritising tasks and maintaining an overview to ensure resources are used efficiently.

•Acting as a support person and sounding board for team leaders.

•Taking responsibility for daily operations when team leaders are not present.

•Contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and ways of working.

•Ensuring a safe, organised, and efficient working environment.

Together as a Team

This is an exciting role with significant influence on daily operations and opportunities to develop your coordination and leadership skills. You will become part of a strong team where collaboration, responsibility, and results are at the heart of everything we do.

If you have ever wondered who is responsible for finding efficient ways to pick and deliver products to our customers, that's us! We are passionate about working together to improve the customer experience at IKEA.

You will be part of our fantastic logistics team, where we strive every day to create a positive working environment that supports the development of our many co-workers. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with co-workers and managers from the Sales department, where strong teamwork is essential to achieving our goals.

Questions and support? Let's connect!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Fulfilment Operations Manager Rune Nielsen at rune.nielsen@ingka.ikea.com.

Please note that we do not accept applications by email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment portal.

If you would like to help create efficient and well-functioning operations every day, we look forward to hearing from you!

Additional Information

•The position is full-time, at 37 hours per week, under an HK salaried employee contract.

•Working hours will be between 2:00 pm and 11:00 pm, including every second weekend from 2:00 pm to 11:00 pm.

•Salary will be based on qualifications and in accordance with IKEA's salary policy.

•We offer a range of employee benefits, including a pension scheme, health insurance, massage services, a staff canteen, employee discounts, discounts with selected partners, an annual gift, and a bonus scheme.

•We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the vacancy once we have received a sufficient number of qualified applications.

•The start date will be as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.

jobs.occupation: Vareopfylder af boligtilbehør til morgenarbejde, 30 timer pr. uge, Odense
jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Who you are

Do you love to get up before everybody else and use your physicality in your work? If so, you could be an ideal fit for a Replenishment co-worker position at IKEA. When IKEA opens its doors at 10 AM, it's crucial that the shelves are well-stocked and prepared for our valued customers. This means that logistics here is not only about replenishing goods, but also about providing exceptional customer service and boosting sales.

To excel in this role, you should:

• Thrive in working during the early morning hours

• Be in good physical condition and thrive by using your body actively

• Possess a keen eye for detail and enjoy working in an organized and structured manner

• Be able to communicate in English and eager to collaborate effectively with the team.

A day in your life with us

Replenishment plays an important part for IKEAs customers and sales, because we make sure our home furnishing accessories are always accessible for our customers. Therefore, we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Your tasks will be:

• Replenishment all our home furnishing accessories such as plates, pillows, lamps, plants etc. on the sales floor using pallet lifter and manual work

• Working together with colleagues from the whole store to keep the store fully stocked

• Handling item counts as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department.

Together as a Team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are, and you will get the opportunity to get a strong social network. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Fulfilment Operations Team Leader Julia Orthmann at juliaorthmann.andersen@ingka.ikea.com. Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Other information

• This position is for an average of 30 hours per week

• Your working time is primarily in the early morning hours from 04am until 10:15am, before the store opens. You should also expect to work every other weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input to the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!
